import requests, collections, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"research-agent/1.0"}
# ---------- recompute everything needed for the summary figure ----------
accs={'HUMAN':'Q8IV36','MOUSE':'Q8R1F6','RAT':'D4A0C3','DICDI':'Q54JJ6','SCHPO_hid1':'O13776',
 'SCHPO_hid3':'Q9P7M6','SCHPO_hid2':'Q9HDV3','YEAST_ECM30':'Q06673','DANRE':'A0AC58J458',
 'DROME':'Q52KA6','CAEEL':'G5EG65','XENTR':'A0A8J0T003','CIOIN':'H2XV68','IXOSC':'A0ACM8DY32'}
S={n:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]) for n,a in accs.items()}
AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62="""A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
sub={}
for line in B62.strip().split("\n"):
    p=line.split()
    for c,v in zip(AA,p[1:]): sub[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
sc=lambda a,b: sub.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(q,t,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(q),len(t); NEG=-1e9
    Mp=[NEG]*(m+1); Xp=[NEG]*(m+1); Yp=[NEG]*(m+1); Mp[0]=0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Xp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    ptr=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        M=[NEG]*(m+1); X=[NEG]*(m+1); Y=[NEG]*(m+1); Y[0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        row=bytearray(m+1); qi=q[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            best=Mp[j-1]; st=0
            if Xp[j-1]>best: best=Xp[j-1]; st=1
            if Yp[j-1]>best: best=Yp[j-1]; st=2
            M[j]=best+sc(qi,t[j-1])
            a=M[j-1]+go; b=X[j-1]+ge; X[j]=a if a>=b else b
            c=Mp[j]+go; d=Yp[j]+ge; Y[j]=c if c>=d else d
            row[j]=st|(0 if a>=b else 4)|(0 if c>=d else 8)
        ptr.append(row); Mp,Xp,Yp=M,X,Y
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([Mp[m],Xp[m],Yp[m]])); pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        r=ptr[i-1][j]
        if state==0: pairs.append((i,j)); state=r&3; i-=1; j-=1
        elif state==1: state=0 if not (r&4) else 1; j-=1
        else: state=0 if not (r&8) else 2; i-=1
    return pairs
hum=S['HUMAN']; L=len(hum); cols=collections.defaultdict(list)
for n,s in S.items():
    if n!='HUMAN':
        for i,j in nw(hum,s): cols[i].append(s[j-1])
cons_id=np.array([np.mean([c==hum[i-1] for c in cols[i]]) if cols[i] else 0 for i in range(1,L+1)])
cons_sim=np.array([np.mean([sc(hum[i-1],c)>0 for c in cols[i]]) if cols[i] else 0 for i in range(1,L+1)])

pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8IV36-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=180).text
at=collections.defaultdict(list); plb={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        n=int(l[22:26]); at[n].append((float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
        if l[12:16].strip()=="CA": plb[n]=float(l[60:66])
N=max(at); plddt=np.array([plb[i] for i in range(1,N+1)])
cent=np.array([np.mean(at[i],0) for i in range(1,N+1)])
D=np.linalg.norm(cent[:,None]-cent[None,:],axis=-1); nbr=(D<10).sum(1)-1
exposed=nbr<=np.percentile(nbr,40)
def patch_max(mask,cut=12.0):
    idx=np.where(mask)[0]; par=list(range(len(idx)))
    def f(a):
        while par[a]!=a: par[a]=par[par[a]]; a=par[a]
        return a
    for a in range(len(idx)):
        for b in range(a+1,len(idx)):
            if D[idx[a],idx[b]]<cut:
                ra,rb=f(a),f(b)
                if ra!=rb: par[ra]=rb
    cl=collections.Counter(f(a) for a in range(len(idx)))
    return max(cl.values(),default=0)
m=exposed&(cons_sim>=0.85)&(plddt>70)
pool=np.where(exposed&(plddt>70))[0]; rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=[]
for _ in range(200):
    mm=np.zeros(N,bool); mm[rng.choice(pool,size=int(m.sum()),replace=False)]=True
    null.append(patch_max(mm))
obs=patch_max(m); null=np.array(null)
pval=np.mean(null>=obs)

basic=np.array([c in "KR" for c in hum]); acid=np.array([c in "DE" for c in hum])
nt=cent[1:20].mean(0); dnt=np.linalg.norm(cent-nt,axis=1)
bins=np.arange(0,70,7.5); mid=(bins[:-1]+bins[1:])/2
netq=[(basic[(dnt>=a)&(dnt<b)&exposed].sum()-acid[(dnt>=a)&(dnt<b)&exposed].sum())/max(((dnt>=a)&(dnt<b)&exposed).sum(),1) for a,b in zip(bins[:-1],bins[1:])]

# Foldseek TM-align results obtained earlier in this job (server output, score/100)
tm={"Ric-8A:Gai 6TYL":0.54,"Ric-8A 6NMG":0.51,"WAPL 4K6J":0.48,"Ric-8A 6N86":0.47,
    "p120-catenin 3L6Y":0.45,"APC-ARM 7F7O":0.44,"APC-ARM 5Z8H":0.43,"APC-ARM 3NMW":0.42,
    "designed repeat 7UE2":0.39,"CNOT9 2FV2":0.36}
tm_ct=0.26

print("SUMMARY NUMBERS")
print(f"  mean %id by region: Nterm2-20 {100*cons_id[1:20].mean():.1f}  solenoid21-570 {100*cons_id[20:570].mean():.1f}  linker571-689 {100*cons_id[570:689].mean():.1f}  Cterm690-788 {100*cons_id[689:788].mean():.1f}")
print(f"  conserved+exposed+confident residues: {int(m.sum())}; largest patch at 12 A = {obs}; null mean {null.mean():.1f} sd {null.std():.1f}; empirical p = {pval:.3f}")
print(f"  net charge per exposed residue by distance from myristoyl anchor: {[round(x,3) for x in netq]}")

fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9))
a=axs[0,0]
ks=list(tm.keys()); vs=[tm[k] for k in ks]
a.barh(range(len(ks)),vs,color="#2a6ebb"); a.barh([len(ks)+0.5],[tm_ct],color="#c0392b")
a.set_yticks(list(range(len(ks)))+[len(ks)+0.5]); a.set_yticklabels(ks+["C-term 690-788\n(best of 1 hit)"],fontsize=8)
a.axvline(0.5,ls="--",color="k",lw=1); a.invert_yaxis()
a.set_xlabel("Foldseek TM-align TM-score vs PDB100")
a.set_title("Residues 1-600 reach the same-fold threshold against\nARM/HEAT solenoids; 690-788 matches nothing")

a=axs[0,1]
regions=["N-term\n2-20","solenoid\n21-570","linker\n571-689","C-term\n690-788"]
vals=[100*cons_id[1:20].mean(),100*cons_id[20:570].mean(),100*cons_id[570:689].mean(),100*cons_id[689:788].mean()]
a.bar(regions,vals,color=["#2ecc71","#2a6ebb","#bdc3c7","#3498db"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): a.text(i,v+1,f"{v:.1f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
a.set_ylabel("mean % identity to human\n(13 orthologs)"); a.set_ylim(0,85)
a.set_title("The C-terminal functional region is the most conserved part")

a=axs[1,0]
a.hist(null,bins=np.arange(-0.5,14.5),color="#bdc3c7",edgecolor="w")
a.axvline(obs,color="#c0392b",lw=2)
a.text(obs+0.2,a.get_ylim()[1]*0.8,f"observed {obs}\np = {pval:.2f}",color="#c0392b",fontsize=9)
a.set_xlabel("largest spatial cluster of conserved exposed residues (12 A linkage)")
a.set_ylabel("random draws (n=200)")
a.set_title("No conserved surface patch beyond chance")

a=axs[1,1]
a.bar(mid,netq,width=6,color=["#c0392b" if v>0 else "#2980b9" for v in netq])
a.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
a.set_xlabel("distance from myristoylated N-terminus (A)")
a.set_ylabel("net charge per exposed residue")
a.set_title("No basic face near the membrane anchor\n(Fisher OR 0.37, p = 0.23)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
